title: How effective is TV advertising for restaurants? (Q4 2025)

facts.fact: Marketing LTB analysis reports that video ads achieve 1.8x higher click-through rates than image-based restaurant campaigns.
facts.quote: achieve 1.8x higher click-through rates than image-based campaigns according to Marketing LTB analysis

facts.fact: Marketing LTB reports that restaurant PPC campaigns convert 6-12% of clicks into reservations or orders.
facts.quote: Restaurant PPC campaigns convert 6-12% of clicks into reservations or orders

facts.fact: The page states that 65% of restaurant revenue comes from repeat customers; no source is named in the passage.
facts.quote: 65% of restaurant revenue coming from repeat customers
